claim: At 3840x2160 with every layout root scaled 2x (1280x960 -> 2560x1920), the engine docks the scaled canvas as it docks the vanilla one at 1080p: the campaign and battle HUDs sit bottom-centred and the front-end pages centred at 2x size; so the root size is what the engine docks (scale_root stays on). The battle radar and the Start Battle box do not reach the top-right corner
notes: run 2026-11-02_j66 shots r2_campaign, r2_land, r2_frontend (1280-wide copies of 3840x2160 frames): campaign HUD x 220..1065 of 1280, battle HUD 210..1070; the radar group sits about 1290 px (4K) left of the right edge, so its placement comes from something other than the layout data (Lua or engine docking; J67)
